scenes.name: The Colonists Come Ashore
scenes.narrationRef: In 1587, nearly a hundred and fifteen English men, women, and children landed on a small island in what would later become North Carolina, led by governor John White.

Keep the capped man's exact face, flat brown cap, full black jaw beard and slate-blue doublet from the second reference image, unchanged. Keep the woman's exact face, middle-parted grey-streaked brown hair in its low bun and long mustard-brown gown from the third reference image, unchanged — do not mix any of these three people's faces, hair, beards or clothes together. The three people named above are the ONLY people drawn in full, and every one of them keeps their own face, their two eyes and all of their own colours exactly as their reference image shows — do NOT turn any of them into a silhouette and do NOT darken their clothes. Draw EXACTLY ONE ship, matching the fourth reference image exactly in shape and colour, floating level on the grey-blue sea band well behind the people, small and far out, with no other vessel anywhere. Keep the background exactly as shown in the last reference image, unchanged: the same pale grey sky, the same straight horizon line, the same grey-blue sea with its three thin lines, and the same pale sandy beach with its two pieces of driftwood across the bottom. The three people drawn in full stand together on the pale sandy beach across the LEFT THIRD and the MIDDLE THIRD of the picture, evenly spaced and NOT overlapping each other, each turned about forty-five degrees toward the viewer with both of their eyes visible. They stand on the same pale sandy beach, spread out in ONE loose band filling the RIGHT THIRD of the picture out to the right edge, with a clear gap of open sand between each of them, every one of them turned the same way the three are facing. Give some of them both arms lowered and some of them one arm raised a little, so the band does not read as one shape repeated seven times. No silhouette may stand in the LEFT THIRD or the MIDDLE THIRD, and no silhouette may touch, overlap or pass in front of any of the three people drawn in full. NOBODY in this picture wears trousers, breeches or shoes of any kind: below each person's single flat garment the legs continue as plain bare thin lines that simply stop at their ends. Every person, drawn in full or silhouette, must be scaled to a normal, consistent human size relative to the driftwood and to each other, standing on the beach and not floating above it, viewed at the same straight-ahead eye-level camera angle as the background reference image, not from above and not from below. scenes.notes: Cảnh đông người đầu tiên của case, bật `crowd: true` theo skill mục 5c-3. Bố cục hai tầng: 3 người VẼ ĐỦ (White + 2 dân thuộc địa có asset) chiếm 2/3 trái, 7 BÓNG ĐEN lấp 1/3 phải — để khung vừa đọc ra 'gần một trăm mười lăm người', vừa còn mặt người cho khán giả bám vào. Tách theo CHIỀU NGANG chứ không phải xa–gần, vì phong cách phẳng không có chiều sâu để đặt bóng ra sau.
